args.description: Cash reconciliation, March 2026: GL Cash-Operating (1000) exceeds the bank closing balance in all three entities by exactly the 3/31 monthly bank service charge, which has not been recorded in the ledger. US $65.00 (BT-US-0084, DOC-0202: GL 1,636,957.20 vs bank 1,636,892.20); UK GBP 22.00 (BT-UK-0055, DOC-0204: GL 552,789.56 vs bank 552,767.56); DE EUR 38.50 (BT-DE-0051, DOC-0203: GL 352,136.36 vs bank 352,097.86). Payroll accounts (1010) tie exactly in all entities; Savings (1020) is nil. No other reconciling items. Combined impact on consolidated cash is USD 134.85 (overstatement) at March Treasury rates. Bank fee entries to Dr 6900 / Cr 1000 are supported by the bank statements but were NOT posted, as the requested deliverable was a read-only ledger-based cash position; flagging for controller direction on whether to book in March.

args.text:
MEMO — Consolidated Cash Position at 31 March 2026
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03 | Status: March 2026 close in progress

PURPOSE
Report consolidated cash at 3/31/2026 in USD, translated at Treasury month-end policy rates, broken out by entity in local currency and USD. Figures are taken from the general ledger only, as requested.

FX RATES USED (Source: DOC-0200, "Month-end FX rates Q1 2026 (Treasury policy rates)", 2026-03-31; USD per 1 unit of currency)
  2026-03 GBP = 1.2500
  2026-03 EUR = 1.1000
Per the document, these rates are to be used for remeasurement, translation and intercompany charges.

CASH BY ENTITY (GL ending balances at 2026-03-31, per get_account_balance, period 2026-03)
US — Halvard Systems Inc. (USD functional)
  1000 Cash - Operating      1,636,957.20
  1010 Cash - Payroll           40,000.00
  1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Total local (USD)          1,676,957.20   @ 1.0000  = USD 1,676,957.20

UK — Halvard Systems Ltd (GBP functional)
  1000 Cash - Operating        552,789.56
  1010 Cash - Payroll           15,000.00
  1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Total local (GBP)            567,789.56   @ 1.2500  = USD   709,736.95

DE — Halvard Systems GmbH (EUR functional)
  1000 Cash - Operating        352,136.36
  1010 Cash - Payroll           12,000.00
  1020 Cash - Savings                0.00
  Total local (EUR)            364,136.36   @ 1.1000  = USD   400,550.00

CONSOLIDATED CASH AT 2026-03-31 = USD 2,787,244.15
  (US 1,676,957.20 + UK 709,736.95 + DE 400,550.00)
Composition: US 60.2%, UK 25.5%, DE 14.4%. USD-denominated 60.2%; 39.8% exposed to GBP/EUR translation.

BASIS AND SCOPE
- Cash defined as accounts 1000, 1010 and 1020 for each entity (full chart of accounts reviewed; no other cash or cash-equivalent accounts exist). Savings accounts (1020) carry nil balances in all three entities.
- Amounts are cumulative GL ending balances (debit less credit) in each entity's functional currency, translated at the March closing rate. This is a spot translation of the cash line only; it is not a full consolidation and does not address CTA (account 3300) or elimination entries.

CORROBORATION AGAINST BANK (control check, not the basis of the figures above)
I tied the GL balances to the March bank statements. All accounts agree except for one identical item in each entity — the 3/31 monthly bank service charge, which is on the bank statement but has not been recorded in the ledger:
  US  GL 1,636,957.20 vs bank 1,636,892.20 — diff USD 65.00  (BT-US-0084; DOC-0202)
  UK  GL   552,789.56 vs bank   552,767.56 — diff GBP 22.00  (BT-UK-0055; DOC-0204)
  DE  GL   352,136.36 vs bank   352,097.86 — diff EUR 38.50  (BT-DE-0051; DOC-0203)
Payroll accounts (1010) tie exactly in all three entities (DOC-0205 US, DOC-0199 UK, DOC-0201 DE). There are no other reconciling items, no deposits in transit and no outstanding checks.

EFFECT OF THE UNRECORDED ITEM
The ledger-based figure above overstates cash by USD 134.85 (65.00 + 22.00 @1.25 = 27.50 + 38.50 @1.10 = 42.35). On a bank-confirmed basis consolidated cash would be USD 2,787,109.30 (US 1,676,892.20; UK GBP 567,767.56 = 709,709.45; DE EUR 364,097.86 = 400,507.65). The difference is immaterial to the cash position but should be booked before the ledger is final.

ACTION TAKEN
- No journal entries were posted. The request was for a read-only cash position from the ledger, and posting the fee entries would have changed the reported figure.
- Logged EXC-001 for controller review covering the three unrecorded bank service charges. The entries (Dr 6900 Bank Fees / Cr 1000 Cash - Operating in each entity) are fully supported by DOC-0202, DOC-0204 and DOC-0203 and can be posted on your instruction.

CAVEATS
- March is still open; the figures will move if further March-dated entries are posted. The bank fees above are the only currently identified item affecting cash.
- Bank statement lines for March are not yet marked as matched in the reconciliation tool (73 lines show unmatched). This is an open reconciliation-documentation task rather than a balance difference — the GL and bank balances agree apart from the three fees noted.

SOURCES: DOC-0200 (Treasury FX rates); DOC-0202, DOC-0205 (US bank statements); DOC-0204, DOC-0199 (UK); DOC-0203, DOC-0201 (DE); GL account balances for accounts 1000/1010/1020, entities US/UK/DE, period 2026-03.
